mapper.sql: u.use_yn = 'Y' and not (u.lock_yn = 'Y' and u.locked_until is null)
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm from sys_user u where u.user_type = 'INTERNAL' and order by u.user_nm, u.login_id limit 2000
select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, () as active from sys_user u where u.user_type = 'INTERNAL' and lower(u.login_id) = lower(#{loginId})

with recursive up (dept_id, parent_id, head_user_id, use_yn, depth, path) as ( select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.head_user_id, d.use_yn, 1, array[d.dept_id] from sys_user me join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = me.dept_id where me.user_id = #{userId} and me.user_type = 'INTERNAL' union all select p.dept_id, p.parent_id, p.head_user_id, p.use_yn, up.depth + 1, up.path || p.dept_id from up join sys_dept p on p.dept_id = up.parent_id where up.depth < 10 and not p.dept_id = any (up.path) ) select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm from up join sys_user u on u.user_id = up.head_user_id where up.use_yn = 'Y' and u.user_id <> #{userId} and u.user_type = 'INTERNAL' and order by up.depth limit 1

select distinct u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm from sys_user u join sys_user_auth ua on ua.user_id = u.user_id join sys_auth_group g on g.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and g.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd and g.use_yn = 'Y' join sys_auth_prog ap on ap.comp_cd = ua.comp_cd and ap.auth_grp_cd = ua.auth_grp_cd where u.user_type = 'INTERNAL' and and ap.prog_cd = #{progCd} and ap.action_cd = #{actionCd} order by u.login_id
